name: Kobold Candles
summary: At the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire, William Pestle seeks candles from kobolds crowding Elwynn's mines. The alchemist has come from his Stormwind shop for their thick wax. His errand brings adventurers face to face with the creatures encroaching on the kingdom's gold veins.

sections.title: Apothecary's Errands
sections.body: William Pestle runs Pestle's Apothecary with his brother in Stormwind City's Trade District. He needs wax for the remedies, ointments, and concoctions he brews. So he turns to Elwynn's kobolds instead of buying polished candles from city merchants. They carry hefty lumps of tallow and wax on their brows, ready for an adventurer to pry loose.

sections.title: The Mines of Elwynn
sections.body: Kobolds have overrun Fargodeep Mine south of Goldshire and Jasperlode Mine to the northeast. They prize their candles above almost everything. The flames guide them through dark shafts as they dig for gold and shiny trinkets. Taking the candles replenishes Pestle's alchemy stocks and weakens the vermin choking off the kingdom's precious mining claims.

faq.q: Why does William Pestle need kobold candles?
faq.answer: William Pestle and his brother run an apothecary in Stormwind's Trade District. They use tallow and wax from large candles in sealing, salves, and other alchemical preparations.

faq.q: Where do you find the large candles?
faq.answer: Kobold workers, vermin, and diggers carry the candles in Elwynn Forest's mines. Look especially in Fargodeep Mine south of Goldshire and Jasperlode Mine to the east.

faq.q: Why are kobolds so obsessed with candles?
faq.answer: Kobolds live in pitch-black tunnels underground and rely on the flames strapped to their heads to see as they dig. Their fear of the dark is superstitious and almost frantic, so they fiercely defend their candles from anyone who tries to take them.
William Pestle is a human merchant and alchemist from Stormwind. Away from his shop in the city's Trade District, he travels to Goldshire to secure cheap materials from adventurers.

faq.q: Does this quest connect to other troubles in Elwynn?
faq.answer: Yes. The kobolds in Fargodeep and Jasperlode Mines threaten Goldshire and Stormwind's economy. Human miners have been driven out, and securing the tunnels is one of Marshal Dughan's top priorities.

faq.q: Are there any other mines infested by kobolds in Elwynn?
faq.answer: Fargodeep Mine and Jasperlode Mine are the two main kobold sites near Goldshire. Their activity also reaches the forest's riverbanks and extends east toward the borders of Redridge.

angles.text: Clearing kobolds for their candles brings prospectors to Elwynn's richest copper and gold veins, abandoned by human miners.
As a human, reclaiming Elwynn's stolen mines and supplying Stormwind's artisans are early duties for a young subject of the kingdom.
As an Alliance member, you help secure local infrastructure while the royal army is stretched thin by internal political strife and missing crown forces.
